name: What are the key components of an AEO strategy for multiple business locations?

mainEntity.name: What are the key components of an AEO strategy for multiple business locations?

acceptedAnswer.text: An effective AEO strategy for multiple locations involves several key components. This includes meticulous optimization of each Google Business Profile (GBP) listing, ensuring consistency of Name, Address, Phone (NAP) data across all online directories and citation sites. It also focuses on generating and managing location-specific content, schema markup for local businesses, and actively acquiring and responding to customer reviews for each branch. Furthermore, it involves understanding and optimizing for natural language queries that AI systems process, ensuring your business's information is readily available and accurately conveyed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key AEO components for multiple locations include optimizing Google Business Profiles, ensuring NAP consistency, generating location-specific content, using schema markup, and managing reviews for each branch.
